headword: {集合住宅|しゅうごうじゅうたく}
reading: しゅうごうじゅうたく

definitions.gloss: apartment building; multi-unit housing; collective housing
definitions.explanation: A building containing multiple dwelling units, such as apartments, condominiums, or public housing.

examples.japanese: {集合住宅|しゅうごうじゅうたく}に{住|す}んでいる。
examples.english: I live in an apartment building.

examples.japanese: {集合住宅|しゅうごうじゅうたく}ではゴミの{分別|ぶんべつ}ルールが{厳|きび}しい。
examples.english: Apartment buildings have strict garbage sorting rules.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}には{高層|こうそう}{集合住宅|しゅうごうじゅうたく}がたくさん{建|た}っている。
examples.english: There are many high-rise apartment buildings in this area.

notes:
{集合住宅|しゅうごうじゅうたく} is the general term for multi-unit housing.

TYPES INCLUDED:
- マンション (condominium)
- アパート (apartment)
- {団地|だんち} (housing complex)
- {社宅|しゃたく} (company housing)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {集合住宅|しゅうごうじゅうたく}の{管理|かんり} (apartment building management)
- {高層|こうそう}{集合住宅|しゅうごうじゅうたく} (high-rise apartment building)

RELATED TERMS:
- {一戸建|いっこだ}て: detached house
- マンション: condominium
- {賃貸|ちんたい}: rental
